MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 3, 2019

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:05 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
  Estates, CA 90274, by VICE CHAIR CARMAN.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  VICE CHAIR CARMAN led those assembled in the salute to the flag

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONER’S PRESENT:  Scott, Medawar, Carman, Yoo, Edler
  COMMISSIONER’S ABSENT:  Schachter, Zigrang

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Manager Naughton
  Associate Planner Thom
  Administrative Assistant Corea

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF AUGUST 5, 2019

  CHAIR CARMAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF AUGUST 5,
  2019

  There being no objection, VICE CHAIR CARMAN so ordered

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-14-19; APPLICANT: MS. IRENE LIM; 50
  RANCHVIEW ROAD; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is requested to
  construct one-story additions into the front and side yard setbacks and increase the existing
  roof height. A Minor Deviation is requested to decrease the front yard area by less than
  10% and for the encroachment of the proposed additions into the required front yard which
  does not project closer to the property line than the forwardmost building line. A second
  Minor Deviation is requested for a single-story addition to be built along existing building
  lines that encroach into a side yard setback that is legally nonfconforming.

  Associate Planner Thom presented Planning Application No. PA-14-19.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT expressed his concern with future proposals to enclose the area
  that is currently being proposed as an open patio cover. Planning Associate Thom stated
  that this could be added as a condition of approval.

  Jonathan Park thanked staff for their assistance with getting this project to this point. He
  stated that several versions were reviewed in order to meeting neighborhood compatibility.
  He further explained that the trellis that is being proposed is to resolve the privacy issue for
  this project since the neighboring property is two stories.

Minutes  1
Planning Commission Meeting
September 3, 2019
   In response to a question by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR, Mr. Park stated that the deck
  will be on the upper terrace.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR, staff stated that the stone work
  on the front of the home is consistent with a home two doors from this home.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER MEDAWAR to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-14-19 AS PRESENTED WITH THE
  CONDITION OF APPROVAL THAT THE AREA ALONG THE NORTH SIDE
  OF THE HOUSE REMAIN EXTERIOR UNENCLOSED SPACE.

  Ayes: SCOTT, MEDAWAR, CARMAN, YOO, EDLER
  Noes:
  Absent: SCHACHTER, ZIGRANG
  Abstain:

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  None

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  None

  10.  PLANNING MANGER ITEMS

  Planning Manager Naughton stated that further time is needed in order to prepare for the
  roof study session. The roof study session will be held at the next Planning Commission
  meeting of October 7, 2019.

  Planning Manager Naughton stated the next GPAC meeting will be held on September 17,
  2019 with the new consultant team from Michael Baker International.
  Planning Manager Naughton stated that she will be providing an update on the Regional
  Housing Needs Assessment to the City Council at their meeting on September 10th and will
  be providing a summary to the Planning Commission at the October 7th meeting.

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, AUGUST 13, 2019

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11-A

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR CARMAN adjourned the meeting at 7:25 p.m. to the Planning Commission
  meeting scheduled on Monday, October 7, 2019.

  Respectfully submitted,

  _______________________________  _____________________
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Heidi Luce, City Clerk
